messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain"
set: ["close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain", "significant improvement in muscle spasm and pain", "one and a quarter to one and a half days", "This applies to patients taking 300 mg/day for at least 2 weeks", "at least 2% of children and teenagers", "at least five days", "taper dose gradually over at least a week", "improvement takes longer", "treatment for at least 5 days in children", "interval of at least 8 hours between doses", "stomach pain in 1% of people", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "at least 6 years old", "6% of patients", "patients with untreated anatomically narrow angles treated with antidepressants", "condition being treated"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
